title: Long-Term Residency (Artist-in-Residence)
source_quote: Applications for the 2026-2027 Long Term and Wood-fire A.I.R programs are CLOSED.
evidence_sentence: Long-term residents have access to a 250 cu. ft. anagama kiln, 60 cu. ft. train kiln, and 25 cu. ft. cross-draft kiln for wood/gas/soda/salt firing.
evidence_quote: Residents have access to a variety of kilns and resources through-out the year, including: 250 cu. ft. Anagama kiln, 60 cu. ft. Train wood fire kiln, 25 cu. ft. Cross Draft wood/gas/soda/salt kiln
summary: Long-term residency (10–12 months) provides access to multiple wood and soda kilns; applications for 2026–2027 are currently closed but rolling applications are accepted for 2027–2028.
how_to_join: Email a portfolio, letter of intent, CV, artist statement, biography, and three professional references to cobbartandecology@gmail.com with subject line 'A.I.R. 2026/27, Application'.
cost_text: Monthly rent $1,200 including utilities; or $950 with 4 hours/week work exchange; or $700 with 8 hours/week work exchange. Residents pay their own material and firing expenses.
commitment: 10–12 months, typically starting July, August, or September
